title: Derived operadic centers in algebraic geometry and deformation quantization
summary: In algebraic geometry, it is well known that Hochschild cohomology and, in particular, the algebraic structure it carries, plays a central role in studying the infinitesimal noncommutative deformations of geometric spaces. This thesis provides, for the first time, an explicit interface between J. Lurie's work on higher centers and the Hochschild cohomology of an algebraic $\mathbb{k}$-scheme within the framework of formal deformation quantization.
